attempts.summary: Configured firewalld on node1 (AlmaLinux 9) as a persistent host firewall permitting only SSH and TCP/8080 inbound, rejecting everything else via zone target REJECT. Verified via firewall-cmd (runtime + --permanent), nftables ruleset inspection, and live port tests (8080 reachable with 200, unrelated ports not exposed via eth0 zone — same-host self-curl artifact via loopback noted and explained). Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and service health, issued `systemctl reboot`, confirmed connection drop/timeout, polled until reachable again, verified boot_id changed, and confirmed firewalld/nftables/sshd all recovered with the identical persisted configuration.
